why.onscreen: 'THE UNIVERSE SHOOK' repeated the title. The script's own 'a billion years later' adds a second hook: how did we feel it?

beats: When two black holes collide, the whole universe shakes.
The crash sends ripples through space and time itself — gravitational waves.
By the time they reached Earth, a billion years later, they stretched every atom on the planet by less than the width of a proton.
It happened a billion years ago. We're just now hearing it.
original.title: When two black holes collide, the universe shakes
